introduction.title: Advanced Reporting and Analytics in PEGA
introduction.text: Reporting and analytics are crucial for business intelligence, performance monitoring, and data-driven decision making. PEGA provides comprehensive reporting capabilities from simple list reports to complex analytics dashboards with real-time data visualization and interactive features.

summary.title: Key Takeaways
points: Advanced reporting encompasses operational, analytical, and regulatory report types
Effective dashboard design focuses on user needs and visual design principles
Real-time analytics enable immediate insights and proactive decision making
Data visualization techniques should match the analysis goals and data characteristics
Performance optimization is crucial for large-scale reporting deployments
Integration with external BI tools extends analytics capabilities
Reporting governance ensures data quality, security, and lifecycle management
Following best practices leads to actionable insights and business value
